        if mr: motion_rows.append(mr)

        rows.sort(key=lambda x: x["frame"])
        for i in range(len(rows)-1):
            r1, r2 = rows[i], rows[i+1]
            dt = r2["frame"] - r1["frame"]

            dx = r2["x"] - r1["x"]
